title: Clarify imported planning provenance and assert it after the second return edit
outcome: Make the planning-versus-evidence boundary explicit and strengthen repeated exchange provenance assertions without changing sync behavior.
acceptance: Task-planning text states that external source snapshots and provenance are absent from planning documents and are not planning-sync dependencies, while explicit disclosure-checked native evidence packs may carry snapshots as inert foreign evidence.

The external-imported bidirectional planning regression asserts Imported origin, the same source_snapshot_id, created_by and created_at after the second-direction source-edit application as well as the first return, retaining all existing document/snapshot equality assertions.
